Q: Need help with MySql query A:

If you want to delete users where any of the records for that user has tonetone as a meta_value, you can do this:

CREATE TABLE wp_usermeta_users_to_delete
( user_id BIGINT(20) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY );
INSERT INTO wp_usermeta_users_to_delete
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM wp_usermeta
WHERE meta_value = "tonetone";
DELETE A. FROM wp_usermeta A INNER JOIN wp_usermeta_users_to_delete B USING (user_id);
DROP TABLE wp_usermeta_users_to_delete;*

Q: Run an async function weekly at a specific time A:

Tienes dos errores principales.

Primero, esta condición siempre invalida "Sunday":

day.capitalize() != "Tomorrow"

Debe ser:

if (
    (day.capitalize() not in days and day.capitalize() != "Tomorrow")
    or not 0 <= hour <= 23
):
    raise ValueError("Invalid date provided")

Segundo, aquí estás ejecutando la función:

function=demo_fx()

Debes pasar la función:

function=demo_fx

Como luego la esperas con await, hazla asíncrona:

async def demo_fx():
    print("hello world")

Y simplifica el scheduler:

async def schedule(delay, loop_time, function, *args, **kwargs):
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)

    while True:
        await function(*args, **kwargs)
        await asyncio.sleep(loop_time)

Uso:

async def sample_task():
    await schedule(
        delay=delay_until("Sunday", 21),
        loop_time=time_from_string(1, "week"),
        function=demo_fx,
    )

asyncio.run(sample_task())

También debes controlar el caso en que hoy sea domingo y las 21:00 ya hayan pasado, porque delay_until() puede devolver un valor negativo. En ese caso debes sumar 7 días al target_day.

Q: Could not get unknown property 'uploadArchives' for task set of type org.gradle.api.internal.tasks.DefaultTaskContainer A:

One of plugins that you are using relies on the older uploadArchives task which is no longer in modern Android Gradle plugin versions.

you should remove that outdated plugin.

Q: Memory dump an app in android A:

HPROF is a dump of heap alone, so it is obviously not all memory. As explained here, Android no longer dumps heap on SIGUSR1 (signal 10) in newer versions. Some useful facts on using /proc/[pid]/mem are given here. In short: your "permission denied" may as well be caused by trying to read the file in wrong way.

EDIT: to read anything, other than /proc/self/mem having debug permissions may be extra useful, see this question for some insights.

Q: Birt viewer cannot load the report query A:

In my case, the datasource for BIRT was not configured correctly. I needed to make sure the JNDI name matched what was in the config for my container.

Q: xcodebuild generating empty compile_commands.json A:

I have found the easiest to use is [bear](https://github.com/rizsotto/bear) which intercepts compiler invocations and automatically generates compile_commands.json

CC=clang bear -- xcodebuild -project ProjectName.xcodeproj -scheme "Scheme" build CC=$CC```

Because xcodebuild uses hardcoded paths by default, you need to override the CC parameter.
